name: crystal-workspace
description: Build and verification machinery for Crystal. Not published: the package is core/, which is published as @crystal-ui/core. The documentation website is its own repository, crystal-preview, and consumes that package.

scripts.test: node tools/build-library.mjs && node tests/core-contracts.cjs && node tools/validate-tokens.cjs && node tools/validate-motion.cjs && node tools/validate-docs.cjs && node tools/verify-package.cjs
